visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds and points to several printed photos pinned to a grey wall. The photos show a younger Asian man with black hair and an older Asian man in professional attire, either in front of a traditional Japanese building or in an office setting. The lighting is soft and indoor. (2) The scene shifts to the younger man outdoors in a lush green forest or park setting. He wears a grey work jacket and is looking down at a string in his hands. The background is slightly blurred with dense foliage. (3) Close-up shots follow, showing thousands of honeybees crawling over a wooden honeycomb frame held by a person. The bees are brown and gold, moving densely over the hexagonal wax structures. (4) Wide shots show several weathered wooden beehive boxes stacked in a field. A beekeeper wearing a protective hat with a net is seen lifting a frame, with dozens of bees flying in the air. The lighting is overcast and natural. (5) The man enters a shop by lifting a white fabric curtain (noren) with large black Japanese calligraphy. Inside, the shop is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting. Shelves are filled with various honey jars, gift boxes, and signage. (6) Close-up shots highlight the honey products, which feature yellow and green lids with traditional Japanese labels. A printer is shown outputting a photo of the two men, which is then held up against the wall of photos. (7) The final shot is a high-quality product advertisement showing a thick square of natural honeycomb being drizzled with liquid honey from a golden spoon.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是我跟社長的故事. (2) [Subtitle]: 去年我到九州拜訪了平本光治社長. (3) [Subtitle]: 這是我的第一次來到九州. (4) [Subtitle]: 他帶我們去參觀他的養蜂場. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後看他的禮盒是怎麼製作完成的. (6) [Subtitle]: 首先他將蜂巢先做好格子. (7) [Subtitle]: 這樣蜜蜂在築巢的時候就會按照他的形狀來製作. (8) [Subtitle]: 接著他們一年只會收成一次. (9) [Subtitle]: 這是為了確保蜜蜂可以有充分的時間休息. (10) [Subtitle]: 通常他們會在六月的時候收成. (11) [Subtitle]: 一年只產出兩萬顆. (12) [Subtitle]: 社長還帶我們去他的直營門市. (13) [Subtitle]: 這裡有非常多的口味可以選擇. (14) [Subtitle]: 他們有做成非常多的禮盒. (15) [Subtitle]: 那麼這個產品去年我們已經跟社長談成了合作. (16) [Subtitle]: 已經成功的將他引進到台灣來. (17) [Subtitle]: 平本社長一直都非常照顧我們. (18) [Subtitle]: 我們可以說是商業上的合作之外也是很好的朋友. [Logo]: @mensgame. [Variety]: 巢みつ. [Slogan]: 極 Kiwami.
